# Which teams have lost the most NBA finals?

Which teams reached the biggest stage of basketball and managed to pile up the most losses in the NBA Finals?

 By Anjum Ash. Updated Jan 15, 2024 / 15:32 EST 

 

Teams with most losses in NBA Finals (Image: FS)

The NBA Championship is the most coveted title in the world of basketball. To excel and trump on the greatest stage of the sport is every professional basketball player’s dream. Since the first NBA finals in 1947, the champions of the Eastern and Western Conference have clashed a total of 77 times for the ultimate title of supremacy. But exactly which teams have lost the most NBA finals?

The Los Angeles Lakers and the Boston Celtics have clinched the most championship titles in NBA history. The two NBA giants have won the Larry O’Brien Championship Trophy a total of 17 times each.

Over the years, several franchises that have appeared in the NBA Finals on more than one occasion, fighting for the ultimate glory. And yet only one would leave as champion, as has been the way of the sport.

Nevertheless, by the end of every season, one of the conference champions would crumble in defeat as their fellow opponents lifted the title. So exactly which franchise has lost the most NBA finals?

## Which teams have lost the most NBA Finals?

The Los Angeles Lakers have lost the most finals in NBA history with 15 Finals losses, followed by the Philadelphia 76ers and New York Knicks with six Finals series losses.

LA Lakers have lost the most NBA finals (via AP)

The Golden State Warriors have recorded five NBA Finals series defeats, while the Boston Celtics, Detroit Pistons, Miami Heat and Cleveland Cavaliers have lost four Finals series each.

## Los Angeles Lakers: 15 Finals Lost

Out of their 32 final appearances, the Los Angeles Lakers won 17 Championships while losing the other 15 Finals series. Their last finals were in 2020, where the Lakers beat the Miami Heat to lift their 17th historic championship title.

The Lakers’ last finals defeat came in 2008 when they lost against the Boston Celtics 2-4 in six games. With 15 defeats out of 32 appearances, the purple and gold have recorded a 46.9% loss percentage in franchise history.

Kobe Bryant in the 2008 NBA Finals (via LA Times)

Compared to the Lakers, the Boston Celtics have won 17 titles in 22 Finals, which makes them the more successful team. The LA Lakers have lost more finals than any other franchise in the league.

## Philadelphia 76ers: 6 Finals Lost

The Philadelphia 76ers played 9 NBA Finals, winning three titles in their franchise history. Out of their six Finals losses, the 76ers lost their last Finals in 2001 against the Los Angeles Lakers. In fact, they also won their last Championship title, beating the Lakers in the 1983 Finals.

The Sixers faced defeat in the 2001 NBA Finals (via BFrames vault)

With six defeats out of nine appearances, the 76ers have recorded a 66.6% loss percentage in their franchise history.

## New York Knicks: 6 Finals Lost

The New York Knicks lost 6 NBA Finals series out of their 8 Finals appearances. They played their last finals vs. the San Antonio Spurs in 1999, which ended in a 4-1 defeat for the Knicks.

1999 NBA Finals (via Knicks photo gallery)

Their last Finals glory came in 1973 when they beat the Los Angeles Lakers to lift the title. With six defeats in eight appearances, the Knicks have recorded a 75% loss percentage in franchise history.

## Golden State Warriors: 5 Finals Lost

The Golden State Warriors have won four Championship titles in just eight years since 2015. Having appeared in 11 Finals series in their franchise history, the Warriors have won a total of six NBA titles.

Their last NBA Finals saw them lift the 2022 NBA Championship. The Warriors faced their last defeat in the 2019 NBA finals, where they crumbled in defeat against the Toronto Raptors.

Stephen Curry after the 2019 NBA Finals heartbreak (via Imago)

With five defeats out of 11 appearances, the Golden State Warriors have recorded a 45.4% loss percentage in franchise history.

# NBA Finals past winners list: Every NBA champion by year, Finals sweeps, most Finals wins and losses

- By
- Nathan Ackerman,

- By
- Nathan Ackerman

Published June 5, 2024 11:10 AM

When Game 1 of the 2024 NBA Finals between the Boston Celtics and Dallas Mavericks tips off on Thursday, there’ll be some history on the line — beyond the obvious. 

The Celtics will be trying to break their current tie with the rival Lakers atop the leaderboard for the most championships in NBA history. Those two teams dominate that board, with a sizable gap between them and the next-fullest trophy case.

Here’s a thorough history of all past NBA Finals winners, including how many titles the Celtics have won, when the Mavericks earned their lone ring and which teams are still searching for their first.

## Who has won the most NBA Finals?

The Boston Celtics and Los Angeles Lakers have won the most NBA Finals, with 17 apiece.

Next is the Golden State Warriors, whose four titles within the last decade brought their all-time total to seven — counting their 1947 win during the era of the Basketball Association of America, which merged with the National Basketball League to become the NBA in 1949.

After them are the Chicago Bulls, whose six championships came in the 1990s with Michael Jordan, and the San Antonio Spurs, who have won five — all with Gregg Popovich at the helm. 

## Who are the last 5 NBA champions?

The 2023-24 season will be the sixth straight season without a repeat NBA Finals winning team. 

## Has there ever been a 4-0 sweep in the Finals?

Several times, actually. The first was in 1959, when the Celtics swept the Lakers (then the Minneapolis Lakers). The last was in 2018, when the Warriors swept the Cavaliers. 

Here are the seven in between. 

### 1975: Golden State Warriors sweep Washington Bullets

### 1983: Philadelphia 76ers sweep Los Angeles Lakers

## How many teams have won a three-peat in NBA history?

Well, three — but it’s happened five times. The first and last were the same franchise: The Minneapolis Lakers three-peated from 1952-54, and the Los Angeles Lakers three-peated from 2000-02.

The Jordan-led Chicago Bulls three-peated twice in the same decade, winning from 1991-93 and again from 1996-98. If Jordan hadn’t retired for the 1993-94 season and most of the next, perhaps it would’ve been an eight-peat. 

Instead, the only eight-peat in NBA history — and probably the only one the league will ever see — belongs to the Boston Celtics. They won the title every year from 1959-66. 

However, there were only eight (until 1961) or nine teams in the league during that Celtics run.

## What teams have never won an NBA title?

The Nuggets won their first championship last year, leaving 10 franchises that have yet to reach the mountaintop: Brooklyn Nets, Charlotte Hornets, Indiana Pacers, Los Angeles Clippers, Memphis Grizzlies, Minnesota Timberwolves, New Orleans Pelicans, Orlando Magic, Phoenix Suns and Utah Jazz.

## Which team has lost the most NBA Finals?

That would be the Lakers, with 15. The next closest are the Knicks and 76ers, with six apiece.

# The Best NBA Teams That Didn’t Win a Championship

Chase Kiddy Jun 16, 2025, 5:24 PM

 

(Jesse D. Garrabrant/NBAE via Getty Images)

Regular-season wins matter very little in the NBA playoffs. That’s absolutely true, full stop. 

That said, it’s rare to see a team win 60 games in the regular season, then flame out in the playoffs. Big-time success in the regular season heavily correlates with championship contention in the postseason.

Since the 1976 NBA merger, there are only four teams that have won 65 games in the regular season but didn’t win the title that year. All four instances are from the last 20 years. 

These are the best teams that never won an NBA championship – according to their regular-season records, anyway.
